analysis.scene_description: The image displays a schematic diagram titled "RAG architecture" on a light gray background. It illustrates the flow of data in a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system. On the left, a "Client" icon (a simple line drawing of a person) sends a "Question" to a central "Framework" (represented by a gear-like network icon). The Framework interacts with a "Vector Database" (a 3D cube icon) via "Semantic Search" and retrieves "Contextual Data". This data, along with "Original Content" and "New Content" (represented by document icons), is sent as a "Prompt" to an "LLM" (Large Language Model), shown as a green circle. The LLM sends output to "Post Processing", which then returns a "Response" to the Client. The bottom half of the image contains a zoomed-in, cropped view of the same diagram's components.
